items.title: Cursor agents gain Computer Use to control desktop apps including iOS Simulator
facts: Cursor can now control your computer.
Agents can drive desktop apps like the iOS Simulator to test the features they build.
Computer Use lets agents click and type across any app on your computer, not just the browser.
Cursor uses it on its own when a task needs it. You can also ask for it by @-mentioning Computer Use in your prompt.

x_posts.author: @qi9098
x_posts.text:
我把 @cursor_ai 新出的 Computer Use 和 Codex 的 Computer Use 对比测试了一下

任务是直接用的 Cursor 官方 demo 里那个，给一个 SwiftUI 写的 iOS 爬山 app 加收藏功能，然后让它自己在 iOS 模拟器里点一遍测试。

分别测试了：
Codex gpt-6-astra high
Codex gpt-6.1-sol high
Cursor Grok 4.7 High

用的是同一句提示词，如下：

You are in the Trailhead project, a small SwiftUI iOS app. Build and run it on the iOS Simulator with ./run.sh. Do all checking of the app's UI with computer use in the iOS Simulator: tap and look at the real app, do not use simctl, screenshots scripts or UI-test code instead. When you are done, reply with a short summary. Add the ability to favorite trails and demo it in the iOS Simulator.

结果：
虽然三个都做成了，但是 Cursor 花的时间差不多是 Codex 的四倍😂

具体成绩：
Codex gpt-6-astra high
2分01秒
Codex gpt-6.1-sol high
2分08秒
Cursor Grok 4.7 High
8分17秒

我分析了一下，
Cursor 主要卡在列表上面的 All 和 Favorites 切换按钮，来来回回点了三分多钟都没切过去。。。
反观Codex 这边，两个模型都是一次就点过去了，还多做了一步，把 app 关掉重开，看收藏有没有保存下来

我本来以为 Cursor 出了这个功能之后，Codex 在 Computer Use 上的垄断要被打破了，没想到 Cursor 这么拉

所以目前来看，个人认为最好的方案还是用 LCU，让任意Agent能够直接调用 Codex 的 Computer Use
链接如下：https://t.co/QXeUnite5M

items.reaction: A developer compared Cursor Computer Use (with Grok 4.7) to Codex models on the official iOS Simulator demo task and found Cursor took roughly four times longer (8m17s vs ~2m), getting stuck repeatedly on a UI button while Codex succeeded quickly and also verified state persistence by restarting the app.

items.title: Claude Code v2.1.310 adds Monitor tool and fixes gateway and cleanup issues
facts: Added the Monitor tool and plugin monitors on Bedrock, Vertex, and Foundry, and when telemetry or nonessential traffic is disabled; long foreground sleeps are now blocked there too
Fixed requests failing behind some gateways and compatible servers that reject the effort-2025-11-24 beta value or mid-conversation system messages; Claude Code now retries without them
Fixed background cleanup deleting some recent files, such as pasted images, when cleanupPeriodDays is set to a very large value
Fixed compaction after a “Prompt is too long” error keeping too much of a conversation with dense text, such as base64 or SVG, so the next request could fail again

x_posts.author: @MrBugia
x_posts.text:
Claude Code still says “Prompt is too long” after compaction?

Oct 23’s v2.1.310 fixes a case where dense text, such as base64/SVG, left too much context behind.

Check your version before repeatedly trimming prompts.

items.title: Moonshot AI launches Kimi K3.1 Pro with strong coding agent performance
facts: We're introducing Kimi K3.1 Pro, the first model in our new K3.1 series and our most capable 3T-class open-weight model to date, with a 1-million-token context window.
Kimi K3.1 Pro and Kimi K3.1 Pro Highspeed are available today on Kimi.ai, Kimi Work, Kimi Code, and the Kimi API. The full model weights will be released by Nov 4.

On Terminal-Bench 4.0, which evaluates coding agents on realistic, resource-constrained terminal tasks using strict task-specific tests, K3.1 Pro scores 65.7%, ahead of GPT-6 Astra (58.2%) and narrowly behind Claude Opus 5.5 (66.4%).

On Kimi Code Bench 3.0 Long-horizon, our internal benchmark that tests coding agents' multi-step execution, tool use, and end-to-end problem solving across diverse engineering domains, K3.1 Pro scores 61.2%, above K3's 55.95%.
